description: A dialog over the main window to start a session on a host, with its first prompt, in a folder there and in a group. It is the same form wherever it opens from; the model, effort and permission mode are not fields but the top bar's, said in the dialog's body line. Once the host has started the session it is listed and opened.
opens: a folder header's + in the sidebar, for a folder on another host that is up: "New session in <folder>, on <host>" (that host first in the Host list)

a folder header's + in the sidebar, while a new chat here would not be listed (this machine's host is not picked in New session's host list, or No group is not among the groups picked in ⋮): "New session in <folder>, through local's server" (host is this machine, said not picked)

Meta's spawn_agent form card (Meta asks for it, may pre-fill its fields, and the person submits the card; heading "Start a chat"): the same fields with a Model row, every live host listed with this machine's first

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: Which words depend on how it opened: "New session on the network" when the host is picked in the dialog; "New session on <host>" when the host is said, not picked (this machine's, "local", or the host the + belongs to when it is the only choice); "Start a chat" in Meta's card.

parts.name: body line
parts.shows: A dimmed line under the heading: "With the top bar's <model> · <effort> · <mode>", listing only what applies: the model's name as the model picker lists it (left out when a model is picked, as the host's own models are offered instead), the effort (left out when the top bar's effort picker is disabled, and the on-device model's own effort when the top bar is on one), and the permission mode's label. Empty (no line) if none applies. These are what the new session starts with; they are not editable here.

parts.name: fields
parts.shows: A two-column grid, 420 wide at least, in a wide dialog (room for a long path): the label in the left column, dimmed and right-aligned (top-aligned for the prompt), the field filling the right column.

parts.name: Host
parts.shows: Label "Host". A drop-down of every live host, each as "<name> (<address>)", or "local" for this machine; the one the + belongs to first, else this machine's first. When the host is said, not picked, it is a plain label with that host's name instead of a drop-down.

actions.does: The folder field becomes the folder last used on that host, else that host's home, else ~ (not when the dialog was opened with a folder). With a Model row, its list becomes that host's models.

parts.name: Model
parts.shows: Only in Meta's card. Label "Model". A drop-down of what the picked host offers to run: its own models by display name (not the Codex default), else the app's built-in model list.

parts.name: Folder
parts.shows: Label "Folder". A text entry, starting as the folder the + belongs to, else the folder last used on that host (kept per host), else the host's home (this machine: the window's current folder), else ~. Empty means ~ (the host's home).

parts.name: Group
parts.shows: Label "Group". A text entry, starting as the one group picked in ⋮ or the one listed (the sidebar's new-chat group for that host), else the host's own group if it says one, else empty. Empty means no group.

parts.name: Prompt
parts.shows: Label "Prompt". A multi-line box in a card frame, at least about 96 tall, wrapping, scrolling, no horizontal scroll, Tab does not insert a tab. Focused when the dialog opens (not in Meta's card). Empty is allowed: the session then starts without a first prompt.

parts.name: Start
parts.shows: "Start" button, the default, suggested style. Dialog only (Meta's card has its own submit button).

actions.does: The prompt, folder (trimmed, ~ if empty), model, effort, mode and group (trimmed, none if empty) go to the host as a start request, and the folder is remembered as that host's last. Model is the top bar's (the model picked, in Meta's card); the mode is the top bar's, but plain default for a Codex model; effort is the top bar's, or none if its picker is disabled. On this machine's host it is started first if it is not running (toast "Starting local's host process…"). When the host answers, the session is listed in its group (that group is added to the groups shown in ⋮ if a filter hides it) and opened; if the host refuses, a note says "<host> didn't start it: <why>".

states.name: host said, not picked
states.shows: Host is a plain label: this machine's ("local"), or the only live host; the dialog's heading names it. Used for this machine when no other live host was given, e.g. the + of a folder whose host is not alive, or the + for a folder on this machine while its chats are not listed.

states.name: no other host alive
states.shows: A New session + for a host that is down is not offered at all (no + on its folder headers). Called without a live host, it falls back to this machine's host, said, with this machine's host process started if it is not running (toast "Starting local's host process…"; if it does not answer in 20 seconds, a note says "local's host process didn't answer: <log path> may say why").

states.name: host offers nothing to run
states.shows: Meta's card only: submitting says "<host> offers nothing to run" and nothing is started.

states.name: start refused
states.shows: A note in the chat: the host's reason after "<host> didn't start it".

states.name: invalid
states.shows: A problem found when starting is shown as a toast over the sidebar (the dialog has closed by then); it does not leave a message in the dialog.
